task.question: In the group stage match between Uruguay and Cape Verde on June 21, 2026, from how many yards away did Kevin Pina score Cape Verde's first World Cup Finals goal?
task.evidence: Kevin Pina scored with a low long range right footed free-kick from 30 yards that went through the middle of the defensive wall and into the bottom right corner of the net, it was the first ever goal for Cape Verde in the World Cup Finals.
